title: Classical emergence of the quantum-backreacted BTZ black hole from exponential electrodynamics
summary: In this work, we revisit a recently reported generalization of the Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole arising in New Massive Gravity sourced by the quantum fluctuations of scalar matter, now examined through the lens of a purely classical framework. We show that the same geometry, distinguished by its logarithmic asymptotic structure, emerges as the unique static solution of Einstein gravity coupled to an exponential nonlinear electrodynamics.
